topic: Choosing Frames after an Eye Exam

script.title: PICKING NEW FRAMES
script.story_hook: A student picks frames after her eye exam.
script.intro_zh: 一位學生做完視力檢查，來到眼鏡行挑鏡框。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we pick glasses frames after an eye exam. Listen for shopping phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們在視力檢查後挑眼鏡框。留意購物相關的說法。
script.outro: New frames ordered, cleaning tips learned. See you Thursday!
script.outro_zh: 鏡框訂好了，清潔訣竅也學到了。週四見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each frame-shopping phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀挑鏡框的說法。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her early twenties with long wavy auburn hair, wearing round mustard earrings, a green corduroy jacket over a cream tee and jeans, slight build, curious smile
script.char_b_description: a bald man in his fifties with a tidy silver beard, wearing a brown vest over a checked shirt, dark slacks and reading glasses on a chain, stocky and patient

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I just finished my exam. I'm here for frames.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ dʒʌst ˈfɪnɪʃt maɪ ɪɡˈzæm aɪm hɪɹ fɚ fɹeɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 你好，我剛檢查完，來選鏡框。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! I'm Gary. Have a seat anywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm aɪm ˈɡɛɹi hæv ə sit ˈɛnɪˌwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎，我是蓋瑞，先坐哪裡都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. So, how do I even start?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks soʊ haʊ du aɪ ˈivən stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。嗯，我該從何選起？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First tell me, what do you need most?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜɹst tɛl mi wʌt du ju nid moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 先告訴我，你最需要什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, distance and near. Both. All at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈdɪstəns ænd nɪr boʊθ ɔl ət wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 就是，遠的、近的，都想一次看清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So progressives, one pair does both.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ prəˈɡɹɛʃəvz wʌn pɛɹ dʌz boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 那就是漸進鏡，一副就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Progressives. Are those the fancy ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /prəˈɡɹɛʃəvz ɑɹ ðoʊz ðə ˈfænsi wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 漸進鏡，是那種高級的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The invisible kind, yes. Ever tried them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɪnˈvɪzəbl̩ kaɪnd jɛs ˈɛvɚ traɪd ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 是看不出分界的那種，你用過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never. Will it feel strange?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ wɪl ɪt fil stɹeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，戴起來會覺得怪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days to adjust, tops.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz tə əˈdʒʌst tɑps/
dialogue.zh: 最多兩天就習慣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I can do two days.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ kæn du tu deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好，兩天我撐得過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, style. Round frames or square?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ staɪl raʊnd fɹeɪmz ɔɹ skwɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 來說說款式，圓框還是方框？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round, I think. My face is too round already!
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd aɪ θɪŋk maɪ feɪs ɪz tu raʊnd ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 圓的吧。我臉已經夠圓了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Round suits you. Try this wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ raʊnd suːts ju traɪ ðɪs wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！你適合圓框，試試這面牆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So many colors... this tortoise one?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmɛnɪ ˈkʌlɚz ðɪs ˈtɔɹtəs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 顏色好多……這隻玳瑁色的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great pick. Hold it up, I'll bring the mirror.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt pɪk hoʊld ɪt ʌp aɪl brɪŋ ðə ˈmɪɹɚ/
dialogue.zh: 選得好。舉起來，我拿鏡子給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, I look like a smart librarian.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ aɪ lʊk laɪk ə smɑɹt laɪˌbɛrˈɛrɪən/
dialogue.zh: 哇，我像個幹練的圖書館員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best kind! Sit, and let's talk money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst kaɪnd sɪt ænd lɛts tɔk ˈmʌnɪ/
dialogue.zh: 最棒的類型！請坐，我們來談錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, my budget's a little tight, um, two hundred?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɹaɪt maɪ ˈbʌdʒɪts ə ˈlɪɾəl taɪt ʌm tu ˈhʌndɹəd/
dialogue.zh: 對喔，我預算有點緊，嗯，兩百美金？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your exam fee counts, so we're good.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ɪɡˈzæm fi kaʊnts soʊ wɪɹ ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 檢查費可以抵扣，所以沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's a huge relief.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðæts ə hjudʒ ɹɪˈlif/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那就安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And do you wear glasses all day long?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd du ju wɛɹ ˈɡlæsəz ɔl deɪ lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那你整天都戴眼鏡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pretty much. Library shifts, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɪti mʌtʃ ˈlaɪˌbɛrˌɛri ʃɪfts ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 差不多，我在圖書館輪班嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then add the blue-light coating.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn æd ðə blʊ laɪt ˈkoʊtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那建議加防藍光鍍膜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that the screen one? How much?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə skɹin wʌn haʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 就是對電腦螢幕的那種嗎？多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the screen pair, fifty extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə skɹin pɛɹ ˈfɪfti ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 就是防螢幕那款，多加五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, my eyes are worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn maɪ aɪz ɑɹ wɜɹð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 值得，眼睛比較要緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal. So, this tortoise pair today?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil soʊ ðɪs ˈtɔɹtəs pɛɹ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。這隻玳瑁的今天帶走？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the green one on the top shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ði ɡɹin wʌn ɑn ðə tɑp ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我喜歡架上那隻綠色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sharp eye. Want to try them on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑɹp aɪ wɑnt tə traɪ ðɛm ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 你好眼力，要試戴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! ...Oh no, these are display only.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs oʊ noʊ ðiz ɑɹ dɪˈspleɪ ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 好！……噢不，這隻是展示用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, demo stock. My mistake, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ dəˈmoʊ stɑk maɪ mɪˈsteɪk ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 啊，拿到試戴的樣鏡了，抱歉，是我沒注意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I can't get this exact pair?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kænt ɡɛt ðɪs ɪɡˈzækt pɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 所以這隻我買不到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can order it. Two days, no extra cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn ˈɔɹdɚ ɪt tu deɪz noʊ ˈɛkstɹə kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 我可以訂，兩天后到，不加錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two days blind as a bat, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz blaɪnd əz ə bæt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那我再當兩天的瞎子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Blind as a bat! Nice one!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ blaɪnd əz ə bæt naɪs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！這句比喻太妙了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's my one idiom for the week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts maɪ wʌn ˈɪdiəm fɚ ðə wik/
dialogue.zh: 這是我這週唯一會的成語啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's write it up. Name and email, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɹaɪt ɪt ʌp neɪm ænd ˈim‿eɪl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 來開單。請留名字和信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Will you text when they land?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn wɪl ju tɛkst wɛn ðeɪ lænd/
dialogue.zh: 好了，貨到了會傳訊息給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll text, and call if you prefer.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛkst ænd kɔl ɪf ju pɹɪˈfɜɹ/
dialogue.zh: 會傳訊息，想接電話也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text is perfect. I'm shy by phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ɪz ˈpɜɹfɪkt aɪm ʃaɪ baɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 傳訊息最好，我怕講電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Pickups run till six.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf ˈpɪkˌʌps ɹʌn tɪl sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，取件時間到六點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six works. Do they come with a case?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks wɜɹks du ðeɪ kʌm wɪð ə keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 六點可以。會附眼鏡盒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Case and cloth, both included free.
dialogue.phonetic: /keɪs ænd klɔθ boʊθ ɪnˈkluːdɪd fri/
dialogue.zh: 盒子和擦拭布，都免費附贈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. And what about my old glasses?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ænd wʌt əˈbaʊt maɪ oʊld ˈɡlæsəz/
dialogue.zh: 好。那我舊的那副怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Recycle bin by the door, or keep them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈsaɪkəl bɪn baɪ ðə dɔɹ ɔɹ kip ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 門口有回收箱，或留著當備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep, definitely. Backups feel safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈdɛfənətli ˈbækˌʌps fil seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 留著，有備用才安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Cleaning tip, before you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈkilnɪŋ tɪp bɪˈfɔɹ ju ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。出門前給你一個清潔小秘訣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please! I've been using my shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz aɪv bɪn ˈjuzɪŋ maɪ ʃɜɹt/
dialogue.zh: 請說！我都用衣服擦鏡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm water, one drop of soap, cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔɹm ˈwɔtɚ wʌn drɑp əv soʊp klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 溫水、一滴洗碗精，再用布擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not paper towels? I ruined two pairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈpeɪpɚ ˈtaʊəlz aɪ ɹuˈind tu pɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 紙巾不行嗎？我之前弄壞兩副了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper scratches coatings. Cloth only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ ˈskɹætʃɪz ˈkoʊtɪŋz klɔθ ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 紙巾會刮傷鍍膜，只能用布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free advice! Are you losing money?
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ədˈvaɪs ɑɹ ju ˈluzɪŋ ˈmʌnɪ/
dialogue.zh: 免費建議！你們不會虧錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our soap bill says yes, but worth it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊɚ soʊp bɪl sɛz jɛs bʌt wɜɹð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 洗碗精買太多會虧啦，不過值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! See you Thursday for the green pair.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ si ju ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ fɚ ðə ɡɹin pɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！週四去拿綠色那副。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday it is. I'll set them aside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ ɪt ɪz aɪl sɛt ðɛm əˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 就週四，我會先替你留。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Gary. This was easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ˈɡɛɹi ðɪs wəz ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，蓋瑞，一點都不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me if the wait feels long, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi ɪf ðə weɪt filz lɔŋ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 等太久就傳訊息找我，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I might do that. Bye, Gary!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ maɪt du ðæt baɪ ˈɡɛɹi/
dialogue.zh: 我大概真的會。拜拜，蓋瑞！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye! Clear days are coming for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ klɪɹ deɪz ɑɹ ˈkʌmɪŋ fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 拜拜！往後就看得清清楚楚了。

這一集跟著一位學生走進眼鏡行，從認識漸進鏡、挑圓框或方框、試戴、談預算與防藍光鍍膜，到最喜歡的顏色沒貨怎麼訂貨取件，把買眼鏡的每一步聽懂。

你會聽到：

- 保養小訣竅：「Warm water, one drop of soap, cloth.」
